segments.text: BLeſſed are thoſe that be vndefiled in the way: and walke in the lawe of the Lorde.
Bleſſed are they that kepe his teſtimonies: and ſeke him with theyr whole heart.
For they which do no wickednes: walke in his wayes.
Thou haſte charged, that we ſhall diligentlye kepe thy commaundementes: O that my wayes were made ſo direct, that I myght kepe thy ſtatutes.
So ſhall I not be confounded: while I haue reſpect vnto all thy commaundementes.
I will thanke thee with an vnfayned heart: when I ſhall haue learned the iudgementes of thy ryghteouſnes.
I will kepe thy ceremonies: O forſake me not vtterly.
As it was in the beginning. &c.
